WITH groups AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_invoices,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups,
    CAST(SUM(count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as avg_count_per_group
  FROM groups
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    g.count, 
    s.avg_count_per_group, 
    s.total_invoices
  FROM groups g, stats s
  WHERE g.count > s.avg_count_per_group
)
SELECT
  SUM(aa.count) as total_invoices_in_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(CAST(aa.count AS REAL) / aa.total_invoices) as avg_share,
  AVG(CAST(aa.count AS REAL) - aa.avg_count_per_group) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg aa
